facts.statement: The genus Caspiodontornis was described by Aslanova and Burchak-Abramovich in 1982.
The only known species is Caspiodontornis kobystanicus.
Caspiodontornis lived during the Late Oligocene epoch.
Caspiodontornis is a genus of prehistoric pseudotooth birds.
facts.quote: Caspiodontornis is a genus of the prehistoric pseudotooth birds.

facts.statement: The genus is placed in the order Odontopterygiformes due to uncertainty regarding its closest relatives.
facts.quote: are here placed in the order Odontopterygiformes to account for this uncertainty

facts.statement: Caspiodontornis belongs to the family Pelagornithidae.
Caspiodontornis lived between 27.3 and 23.04 million years ago during the Chattian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Chattian to Chattian (27.3 to 23.04 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Fossils consisting of a fairly complete skull and beak were found in early Late Oligocene rocks at Pirəkəşkül in Azerbaijan.
rejected.quote: Its remains – a fairly complete skull and beak – were found in early Late Oligocene (Chattian, MP25-30) rocks at Pirəkəşkül (Azerbaijan)
